description: The count of trades delinquent 90 days or worse does not exceed the count delinquent 60 days or worse.
explanation: A trade reaching the 90-day delinquency threshold is necessarily also included among trades reaching the 60-day threshold.

description: The total trade count is at least the count of trades with high utilization.
explanation: High-utilization trades are a counted subset of the applicant's recorded credit trades.

description: The sum of the two trade-age fields is at least -18, allowing their documented unavailable-value codes while remaining nonnegative when both ages are observed.
explanation: For observed bureau ages, both elapsed-month values are nonnegative. The documented special codes are no lower than -9, so even when either field is unavailable their sum cannot be below -18; this avoids interpreting an unavailable oldest-trade value of -8 as an ordinary age in the original ordering inequality.

description: The total trade count is at least the count of satisfactory trades.
explanation: Satisfactory trades are a counted subset of all credit trades recorded for the applicant, and repository preprocessing explicitly enforces this coverage.

description: The total trade count is at least the count of trades initiated during the last year.
explanation: Trades opened during the last year are a subset of all trades in the bureau file, and repository preprocessing explicitly enforces this coverage.

description: The total trade count is at least the count of revolving trades carrying a balance.
explanation: Revolving trades with a current balance are counted among the applicant's total recorded trades, and repository preprocessing explicitly enforces this coverage.

description: The total trade count is at least the count of installment trades carrying a balance.
explanation: Installment trades with a current balance are counted among the applicant's total recorded trades, and repository preprocessing explicitly enforces this coverage.

description: The six-month inquiry count is at least the six-month inquiry count excluding the immediately preceding seven days.
explanation: Removing the most recent seven days from a six-month inquiry window can only remove inquiries, so the resulting count is a subset of the original six-month count; the repository's sentinel conventions preserve this ordering when unavailable values occur.

description: The count of revolving trades carrying a balance is at least the count of high-utilization bankcard or national trades.
explanation: A trade classified as high utilization has a balance relative to its credit limit and is a revolving bankcard or national trade, so it is included among revolving trades with a balance.

description: The total trade count is at least the combined counts of revolving and installment trades that carry a balance.
explanation: Revolving and installment accounts are distinct trade categories, and the balance-carrying accounts in those two categories are therefore disjoint subsets of all recorded trades.

description: The average age of trades in the bureau file is at least the age of the most recently opened trade.
explanation: Among observed trades, the most recently opened trade has the smallest months-since-opened value, so an average age cannot be below it; the source fields use compatible nonnegative observed values and documented unavailable codes.
